changes.moveit_preselection: Require connected pregrasp, approach, grasp and retreat feasibility before TARGET_SELECTED is published.
changes.deterministic_ranking: Evaluate clearance, uncertainty and confidence groups in order; use MoveIt joint travel and track ID only inside the first feasible group.
changes.bounded_cache: Reuse an evaluation only within 5 mm target-pose drift and invalidate all current-state results after a completion tombstone.
changes.stale_result_guard: Discard evaluation callbacks from superseded epochs or completed tracks.
changes.transient_failure_policy: Defer on backend busy, service unavailability or collision-scene synchronization failure instead of caching a false unreachable result.
